title: 第四章陆判第五章婴宁第六章辛十四娘
lines: 第四章陆判
陵阳有个书生，姓朱，名尔旦，字小明。
他生性豪爽，不拘小节，就是有些迟钝。读书读得慢，别人三遍能背的文章，他要读三十遍。背下来了也不解其意，解了其意也不会用，用了也用不到点子上。考了七八年，连个秀才都没中上。
但他有个好处——胆子大。
陵阳城北有一座十王殿，殿里供奉着十殿阎罗的塑像，一个个面目狰狞，青面獠牙，当地人都不敢靠近。尤其是殿东边那尊陆判官像，塑得格外逼真，绿面赤须，双目圆睁，手里握着一支朱笔，像是随时要在生死簿上勾一笔。旁人看一眼就腿软，朱尔旦却不怕。
这天，朱尔旦和几个朋友喝酒。酒过三巡，有人拿他打趣。
“朱兄，你不是胆子大吗？你要是敢半夜去十王殿，把陆判官的塑像背出来，我们请你喝一个月的酒。”
朱尔旦一拍桌子：“这有什么难的！”
他起身就走。朋友们在身后笑，以为他说大话。
朱尔旦一个人走到十王殿。殿里黑漆漆的，只有神像前的长明灯亮着，火苗一跳一跳的，照得那些塑像的脸忽明忽暗。朱尔旦走到陆判官像前，拱了拱手。
“陆公，在下朱尔旦，得罪了。”
他把塑像往背上一背，出了殿门，一路走回酒馆。朋友们见他真把塑像背回来了，一个个吓得面如土色，他却面不改色，把塑像往桌上一放，倒了三杯酒，一杯敬塑像，一杯自己喝了，一杯泼在地上。
“陆公，请。”
那天夜里，朋友们都散了。朱尔旦一个人在家喝酒，喝着喝着，忽然听见有人敲门。
他打开门——门外站着一个绿面赤须的汉子，穿着官服，手里握着一支朱笔。
朱尔旦愣了一下，随即笑了：“陆公？您来了？”
陆判官走进来，也不客气，往桌前一坐。
“朱生，你方才背我出来，又敬我酒，这份胆量，难得。”
朱尔旦给陆判官倒了杯酒，两人对饮。喝到半夜，陆判官忽然看着他，说了一句话。
“朱生，你读书读不进去，你知不知道为什么？”
“为什么？”
“你的心窍不通。”
朱尔旦叹了口气：“我也知道。读了十几年了，越读越糊涂。”
陆判官笑了笑：“这有何难。我替你换一颗心就是了。”
【天书一笔】
陆判官说这话的时候，天书微微亮了一下。
不是因为这话有多重，而是因为——这句话本身，就是一个因果的开始。
朱尔旦的功德簿上，只有薄薄一层。他读书虽笨，但为人正直，不欺不诈，孝敬父母，待友真诚。功德不大，但干干净净。
而陆判官——他本是冥府判官，掌人生死，断人善恶。他插手人间事，替人换心，这事在功德簿上，没有先例。
天书不动。只是等着。
朱尔旦以为自己听错了。
“换心？怎么换？”
陆判官让他躺下，从袖中取出一柄小刀，剖开他的前胸。朱尔旦只觉得心口一凉，不疼不痒。他低头一看，自己的心脏被取了出来——拳头大小，上面密密麻麻地堵着许多东西，像是被淤泥塞住的河道。
“看到了吧？”陆判官说，“心窍堵了，自然读不进去。”
他把那颗心放在桌上，又从袖中取出一颗新的，塞进朱尔旦的前胸里。合上伤口，没有一丝血迹。
“好了。”
朱尔旦坐起来，摸了摸心口，什么痕迹也没有。
陆判官站起来，要走。朱尔旦拉住他。
“陆公，我还有一事相求。”
“什么事？”
“我妻子……”朱尔旦犹豫了一下，“她什么都好，就是相貌普通了些。我想……”
content_en:
Chapter 4 Lu Judge
There was a scholar in Lingyang, whose surname was Zhu, whose name was Erdan and whose courtesy name was Xiaoming.
He is bold and informal by nature, but a little slow. He reads slowly. He has to read an article thirty times that others can memorize three times. Even if you memorize it, you still won’t understand its meaning. Even if you understand its meaning, you won’t be able to use it. Even if you use it, you won’t be able to use it to the point. After taking the exam for seven or eight years, I didn't even get the chance to become a scholar.
But he has one good thing - he is bold.
There is a Palace of Ten Kings in the north of Lingyang City. There are statues of Yama in the Ten Palaces enshrined in the palace. Each of them has a ferocious look, green face and fangs, and the locals do not dare to approach. Especially the statue of Judge Lu in the east of the hall is particularly lifelike, with a green face and red beard, eyes wide open, and a red pen in his hand, as if he is about to make a mark on the book of life and death at any time. Others will feel weak in the knees after just one look, but Zhu Erdan is not afraid.
On this day, Zhuerdan drank with some friends. After three rounds of drinking, someone made fun of him.
"Brother Zhu, aren't you brave? If you dare to go to the Ten Kings Palace in the middle of the night and carry out the statue of Judge Lu, we will treat you to drinking for a month."
Zhu Erdan slapped the table: "What's so difficult about this!"
He got up and left. His friends laughed behind him, thinking he was exaggerating.
Zhuerdan walked to the Ten Kings Hall alone. The hall was dark, with only the long lamp in front of the statues on. The flames danced, illuminating the faces of the statues. Zhu Erdan walked to the statue of Judge Lu and bowed his hands.
"Mr. Lu, I, Zhu Erdan, have been offended."
He put the statue on his back, walked out of the palace gate, and walked all the way back to the tavern. When his friends saw that he had really carried the statue back, their faces turned pale with fright, but he remained calm and put the statue on the table. He poured three glasses of wine, one to toast the statue, one to drink himself, and one to pour on the ground.
"Mr. Lu, please."
That night, the friends dispersed. Zhuerdan was drinking alone at home, and while he was drinking, he suddenly heard someone knocking on the door.
He opened the door - standing outside the door was a man with a green face and a red beard, wearing official uniform and holding a red pen in his hand.
Zhu Erdan was stunned for a moment, then smiled: "Mr. Lu? Are you here?"
Judge Lu walked in and sat down at the table without being polite.
"Zhu Sheng, you just carried me out and toasted me with wine. This kind of courage is rare."
Zhu Erdan poured Judge Lu a glass of wine and they drank together. After drinking until midnight, Judge Lu suddenly looked at him and said something.
"Zhu Sheng, you can't get into reading, do you know why?"
"Why?"
"You're out of your mind."
Zhu Erdan sighed: "I know too. I have been reading it for more than ten years, and the more I read, the more confused I become."
Judge Lu smiled: "What's the problem? I'll just change your heart for you."
【One Stroke of Heavenly Book】
When Judge Lu said this, the heavenly book lit up slightly.
Not because of the weight of these words, but because - this sentence itself is the beginning of cause and effect.
There is only a thin layer in Zhu Erdan's merit book. Although he is stupid at reading, he is upright, does not cheat or deceive, respects his parents, and is sincere to his friends. Not much merit, but clean.
And Judge Lu - he was originally the judge of the underworld, controlling life and death, and judging people's good and evil. He intervenes in human affairs and changes people's hearts. This has no precedent in the book of merit.
The Book of Heaven does not move. Just wait.
Zhu Erdan thought he heard wrongly.
"Change your heart? How?"
Judge Lu asked him to lie down, took out a knife from his sleeve, and cut open his chest. Zhu Erdan only felt a chill in his heart, neither pain nor itching. He looked down and saw that his heart had been taken out - it was the size of a fist, and it was densely blocked with many things, like a river blocked by silt.
"Did you see it?" Judge Lu said, "My heart is blocked, so naturally I can't read it."
He put the heart on the table, took out a new one from his sleeve, and stuffed it into Jourdan's chest. When the wound was closed, there was no trace of blood.
"Okay."
Zhu Erdan sat up and touched his heart, but there was no trace.
Judge Lu stood up and wanted to leave. Jourdan grabbed him.
"Mr. Lu, I have one more thing to ask of you."
"What's the matter?"
"My wife..." Zhu Erdan hesitated, "She is good at everything, but her appearance is a bit ordinary. I think..."
